name: Personal Assistant - Fractured Minds
source:
What if everything you've come to know about Marshal, Rachel, and Kennedy were just the tip of the iceberg?

What if the events over the last 2 years with Rachel and Kennedy were just a setup for his true intentions?

And what if even Marshal himself wasn't aware of his own reasons?

Personal Assistant: Fractured Minds brings the old cast back, joined by some new faces, to finally get Marshal to confront his fears from when he was young.

Were his assistants only his? Was he in control, or were there unknowns hiding in the dark, waiting for him to fail, and come in and take control of what is his?

Join the trio, and help discover what is hiding in Marshal's FRACTURED MIND!

[From [url=https://bhgpawp.itch.io/personal-assistant-fractured-minds-v1]itch.io[/url]]
